summary: Bank of Nova Scotia filed a 6-K containing only consolidated capitalization and earnings ratio tables as of April 30, 2026. The exhibits (99.1 and 99.2) present subordinated debentures, equity breakdown, and IFRS-based earnings-to-fixed-charges ratios for the six-month period and prior five fiscal years. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation components. This is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a non-material U.S. Form 8-K filing. No action, recommendation, or deal terms exist. Filing is strictly informational with no event to categorize.
